note: Primary: Kojima Productions news, 'DEATH STRANDING ISOLATIONS new details and teaser revealed' (kojimaproductions.jp/en/node/306, 30 Oct 2026; read 02:00Z via its news list): animated series streaming exclusively on Disney+ or other Disney services in 2027; new story separate from the games, set after Sam reconnects America through the Chiral Network; a girl who chose isolation; hand-drawn 2D animation by E&H production; director Takayuki Sano; series composition and screenplay Tow Ubukata; the key visual credits Hideo Kojima as executive producer. Footage: the teaser exists only on YouTube and X, so under the trailer-news rule the Reel uses the official art with motion (three Kojima Productions images: character art Nov 2025, cover image and teaser key visual Oct 2026); Mohammad asked for the file (card prod-20261030-isolations-teaser-file). Sound: our bed (stills).
